parts: Governed policy basis: the review count and slots are the strictest DEC-110 workflow policy among the content types the subject is bound to (a template or pattern version's `compatibleTypeIds`; for a taxonomy version the content types of the caller's owner scope whose keys appear in `allowedTypeKeys`)
each resolved through the fail-closed `cms_editorial_workflow_policy_evidence` seam
the basis is the array of `{ contentTypeId, policyKey, policyVersion, policyHash }` sorted by `(policyKey, policyVersion, contentTypeId)`
`risk_class` is `protected` if any member is protected, `required_decision_count` is the largest member count
`required_capabilities` is the base slot `cms.reviewer` followed by each specialist capability in order of first appearance (at most 16)
a subject with no resolvable bound type uses the registry member `editorial.default` version 1 (`CMS_GOVERNED_DEFAULT_POLICY`)
`policy_basis_hash` is the lowercase SHA-256 of the JCS basis array.
